title: Projects
subtitle: Production systems across healthcare, fintech, travel booking, and SaaS foundations

items.name: Tapsi Doctor Platform
items.description: National telehealth frontend across five production surfaces — patient app, consultation suite, operations console, physician workspace, and Raasti Kit design system — unified on Next.js 15 App Router with SSR, domain packages, and realtime care flows.
items.role: Senior Frontend Engineer · Architecture & delivery ownership
highlights: Own frontend delivery across 5 production products and align sprints with product and design so polish and technical risk move together
Migrated critical surfaces from Pages Router to Next.js 15 App Router with Server Components, SSR, SSG, and route-level splitting — ~40% faster initial load; 15 pages converted to SSR
Designed and published a shared DDD-inspired TypeScript package so teams stopped reinventing booking and visit rules in UI code
Architected Raasti Kit — npm-distributed design system with Storybook, design tokens, and bundle budgets — adopted by 5 teams
Shipped JWT role-based health UI and realtime teleconsultation with SignalR; physician analytics on React 19 + Vite with Vitest, Husky, and production monitoring

products.name: Patient app — Medicine ordering & online consultation
products.description: Patient-facing product for ordering medicine and booking online medical consultations — specialty discovery, physician profiles, pharmacy checkout, document upload, and live consult status.
highlights: Architected public surfaces on Next.js 15 App Router with SSR/SSG for specialty and physician discovery (SEO + TTFB), and client islands for checkout, consult booking, and uploads
Designed dual journeys — medicine order and consultation — sharing layout shells, auth gates, and design-system primitives
Owned performance and accessibility on high-traffic patient paths, including focus management and reduced layout shift on SSR-hydrated pages

products.name: Operations console — Order panel
products.description: Internal order-management console for pharmacy and delivery operations — order lifecycle, filters, status transitions, and high-volume fulfillment tooling.
highlights: Led authenticated App Router architecture with role-aware navigation and isolated modules for order list, detail, and lifecycle actions
Built data-dense tables and URL-synced filters tuned for operator speed under national-scale volume
Wired realtime status updates so fulfillment changes appear without refetch storms

products.name: Physician workspace — Doctor panel
products.description: Doctor-facing workspace for online consultations — visit queues, patient context, messaging/call flows, and analytics on React 19 + Vite.
highlights: Architected clinical workspace shells for queue + active visit with realtime SignalR messaging and status flips
Delivered physician analytics on React 19 and Vite with Vitest, Husky, and release ownership through production monitoring
Prioritized accessibility for dense clinical UI — keyboard-first queues, focus traps, and predictable tab order

products.name: Consultation suite — Visit management
products.description: Visit-management suite coordinating consultation lifecycle across patients, physicians, and operations — scheduling, queue health, and cross-product status consistency.
highlights: Modeled visit lifecycle UI with shared domain types from the DDD package — one vocabulary across patient, physician, and ops products
Built coordination views with realtime updates so ops see the same visit truth clinicians and patients experience

products.name: Raasti Kit — Shared design system
products.description: Npm-distributed design system with Storybook, design tokens, and bundle budgets — one interaction language for design and engineering.
highlights: Architected and published Raasti Kit for adoption across five teams, reducing duplicate UI
Enforced tokens and bundle budgets so design-system growth stayed measurable in production

items.name: Travel Booking Experience
items.description: Cross-platform travel booking product UI across React Native and Next.js — search, listing, and checkout with TanStack Query, WCAG-aligned forms, and Lighthouse-driven performance work.
highlights: Built travel booking across web and mobile with React Native, Next.js, and TanStack Query
Partnered with design on search, listing, and checkout — including WCAG-aligned forms so travelers could complete bookings without accessibility dead ends
Diagnosed slow booking screens against Lighthouse budgets; introduced code splitting, lazy loading, and SCSS delivery standards on high-intent paths

items.name: Greenfield Next.js Foundations
items.description: Private MVP foundations on Next.js 15 App Router — routing conventions, SSR strategy, JWT API integration, feature-based structure, and shadcn/ui standards for early product teams.
highlights: Set greenfield App Router architecture so founders and small teams could ship without reinventing structure every week
Standardized forms, client state, and realtime patterns (React Hook Form, Zustand, Socket.IO) with architecture notes for handover
Established feature-based structure and shadcn/ui standards that held after engagement end

items.name: Nobitex Trading Experience
items.description: High-traffic cryptocurrency exchange UI — trading and account features, Socket.IO market dashboards, and a shared shadcn/ui + Storybook library that improved key-flow page load by about 25%.
highlights: Shipped trading and account features in React and TypeScript with JWT sessions under spike market activity
Built and hardened Socket.IO dashboards for order books, tickers, alerts, and notifications
Improved key-flow page load by about 25% through rendering, bundle, and asset work
Drove adoption of a shared shadcn/ui and Storybook library that reduced duplicate components across teams

items.name: Axon — Growth Site & CRM
items.description: SEO-oriented marketing surfaces for axon.me plus CRM tables, admin dashboards, and multi-step workflows — Redux state and BEM CSS that sped delivery for sales and operations.
highlights: Built SEO-oriented landing pages and responsive SCSS patterns with marketing and SEO stakeholders
Delivered CRM tables, admin dashboards, and multi-step workflows that cut repetitive manual work
Introduced Redux for multi-page predictability and BEM modular CSS for fewer style regressions
